evidence: This transcript must demonstrate the candidate's compliance with the following courses: Biological Sciences; Physical Sciences; Social/Behavioral Sciences; Statistics. The program requires the following prerequisites prior to admission: 3 social science credits, 3 biological science credits, 3 physics or chemistry credits and 3 statistics credits.
why: the programme's web pages carry no requirements; the list is published only in the MSLP Student Handbook PDF, which the worker's candidate search does not reach from the programme page
conditions: Bachelor's degree or equivalent from an accredited institution with a minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale. Courses taken only as a prerequisite do not count toward the admission GPA. At the time of evaluation a candidate may have at most two of the required courses in progress. Admission is for the fall semester only, and includes an interview, a written essay and letters of recommendation.

courses.name: Biological Sciences
courses.details: 3 credits. Biology, human anatomy and physiology, neuroanatomy and neurophysiology, human genetics, or veterinary science.

courses.name: Social/Behavioral Sciences
courses.details: 3 credits. Psychology, sociology, anthropology, or public health.

courses.name: Statistics
courses.details: 3 credits. A stand-alone course in statistics is required; research methodology courses in communication sciences and disorders may not be used to satisfy it.
